profile.headline: Full-Stack Software Engineer | 20 Years Experience | .NET | JavaScript | SQL | Available for Consulting
profile.summary:
I'm a software engineer with 20 years of experience building and delivering systems across industries including defense, aerospace, and manufacturing. I've worked on everything from SCADA systems and assembly line error proofing to web-based project tracking and reporting tools — deployed at client sites across the US, UK, Mexico, Poland, and China.
 
My background is primarily in .NET, C#, JavaScript, TypeScript, and SQL Server. I'm currently expanding into modern full-stack web development and available for freelance contracts through my company, Carl Michael LLC.
 
I bring more than just code to a project. I've gathered requirements directly from clients, led teams, managed timelines, performed code reviews, and provided 24/7 support for production systems. I know how to communicate with both technical teams and end users.
 
If you need a seasoned engineer who can jump in, figure it out, and get it done — let's connect.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Skills
Developed applications using C#, VB.Net, ASP.Net, ASP.Net MVC, Microsoft SQL Server, and JavaScript

Used Visual Studio Team Services to create and generate builds and releases

Used Visual Studio Team Services to track bugs, product backlog items, features, and epics 
during the software development process 

Used ADO.Net, Language-Integrated Query (Linq), and Entity Framework to communicate to databases 

Setup devices in RSLinx and Kepware to create Open Platform Communications (OPC) connections for the software system 
•	Assembly Management System

Lead developer for the Assembly Management System which increases the efficiency for manufacturing plants by providing control and order to the manufacturing process and by limiting mistakes and providing accountability and traceability to the manufacturing process

Created and designed tasks to be completed by members of the team

Lead design discussions to determine the approach and direction of the system

Responsible for integration of the system with new and existing systems in the manufacturing plant

Interfaced with clients to determine project requirements and deadlines

Worked with management to develop project proposals, timelines, and costs

Provided first tier 24/7 support for the system

Commissioned the system in plants located in the United States, Poland, China, and Mexico

Provided system training to ensure a proper hand over of the system to client

Created system help documentation for system troubleshooting and learning

Facilitated a training seminar to train on new features of the system and train new personnel on the system

Traveled to several countries for system commissioning, product runoffs, system integrations, system support, training, and requirements gathering

Lead weekly meetings with clients to discuss system performance and enhancements

Worked in both a traditional waterfall and in an agile development environment

positions.title: software engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed applications using several programming languages which included VB.Net, C#, ASP.Net, SQL, and WPF that interact with tools via OPC servers and PLCs
•	Created custom applications to interface with human users and with hardware 
•	Responsible for supporting and maintaining existing systems 
•	Installed new systems, which includes installing both client and server applications
•	Created help documentation and presentations for the end customer using tools in Microsoft office
•	Gathered requirements for software projects
•	Traveled to client sites to perform installations, upgrades, onsite support, and to provide training
•	Created documentation for custom applications
•	Responsible for software testing and code reviews
•	Provided 24/7 support for clients both inside and outside of the United States
•	Provided estimates on the amount of effort needed to complete jobs
•	Assigned tasks to fellow employees and ensured that the tasks were completed and the team was staying on track
•	Conducted training sessions to educate system engineers on how to properly operate and diagnose issues on a complex system
